title: Qualify delivery/fetch adapters and interrupted success recovery
description: Real remote transport classification, provider receipt identity, deploy idempotency and stopped-executor attestations remain unqualified. Develop non-effectful/dry-run harnesses first; any real destination, credentials, push or deploy requires separate owner scope. Local green receipts are not production evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Classified retries apply only to safely retryable failures and unknown effects stop
External-success reconciliation never re-executes an already applied operation
Owner sees exact delivered version and failure/status evidence without raw secrets
